name: devteam (antigravity)
description: A small development team on Antigravity: a coordinator (Hydrogen) who plans and reviews, an implementer (Carbon) who builds, a redteam reviewer (Hydrogen) who tries to break the work, and a curator (Hydrogen) who keeps notes and docs tidy. Until Antigravity offers Gemini Hydrogen, the Hydrogen seats run on Gemini 3.8 Flash.
